Look up the labels of members

Source: R/labels.R
scale_label.Rd

Returns one display name per code. A code without a label of the chosen variant is returned unchanged, so the result is always usable as an axis or legend text. NA in members stands for the frame itself and returns the frame's label, or its name when it has none.

Usage

scale_label(x, members, frame, variant = NULL)

Arguments

x

A NestedScale.

members

Character vector of member codes at frame.

frame

The frame the codes are at.

variant

The label variant. NULL uses the scale's default, see attach_labels_scale().

Value

A character vector as long as members.

See also

attach_labels_scale(), scale_labels()

Examples

s <- attach_labels_scale(
  scale_example(),
  data.frame(frame = "sector", member = c("P", "S", NA),
             label = c("Primary", "Secondary", "Sector"))
)
scale_label(s, c("S", "P", "T"), frame = "sector")
#> [1] "Secondary" "Primary"   "T"        
scale_label(s, NA, frame = "sector")
#> [1] "Sector"
scale_label(s, c("G1", "G2"), frame = "class")   # no labels: the codes
#> [1] "G1" "G2"
